description: Membership aggregate with a private-state entity, an immutable Money value object, a domain event and an orchestrating application service, except Membership.renew() fetches the tier price over HTTP with axios inside the domain entity

hard.note: The model is otherwise rich (behavior on the entity, guarded state, immutable value object, thin application service); the only defect is one HTTP call inside an entity method

_calibration.note: Single planted infrastructure-in-domain leak, which makes the entity untestable without the network (error per the agent's Severity line); a second finding tolerated if the agent reports the axios import and the call separately; the expiry getter leaked the mutable internal Date and renew() accepted any renewalTermMonths, both fixed after the opus stress run 20261116T110405Z reported 3-7 issues
